strings.en: I need to be careful...!
I can see you clear as day!
I'll be useful to everyone, I swear!
If I make the most of the GG loadout...!
This is no time to be trembling!
I didn't come out here just for fun...!
Don't miss, Akemi!
I know!
Ammo check... We're good!
So we're going for a full barrage!
Akemi, aim carefully!
Right!
Akemi, with your skills you can hit it!
Easy for you to say!
I'll trust in Soul Saber's performance/　and give it a shot!
I'm counting on you, Soul Saber!
It's still in GG range!
I've already got a fix on their position!
Don't slip up, Akemi!
In range! Here I go!
Yeah, got it!
You can see it too, right, Akemi?!
Yes, I'm going in!
Time to strike back, Akemi!
If you dawdle, they'll get away!
Don't rush it... Aim properly!
Hurry and counterattack!
It's fine... They're still in range.
Here we go, Super Soul Saber!
I'm counting on you, Super Soul Saber!
Don't think you can escape/　from this Super Soul Saber!
I'll make sure I don't cause you two any trouble!
Don't worry about us.
Yes. Do as you see fit.
The timing's tricky, but...!
I'll leave it to your judgment, Akemi.
Against that one...!
Let's do this, Super Soul Saber!
I'm not backing down like this!
Then there's only one thing to do.
We're counterattacking!
Right!
Let's trust in Super Soul Saber's performance.
Yeah, let's go!
Be very careful with the Siebe Drive!
I know, Fairy!
Fairy, how's the Siebe Drive?
No need to worry. It's stable.
A Zovorg commander unit...!
Akemi, it's a Zovorg commander unit!
Yes, we need to be careful...!
That type is actually the scary kind...!
That's the head of Golaikunru...?!
Here I come, Jua-Mu!
Jua-Mu, you'll have to deal with us too!
I won't let his momentum overwhelm me...!
Jua-Mu! I won't give an inch here!
Even against Al-Van,/　we have to have a chance somewhere!
The Raftclans moves fast...!
But we've got more than two eyes on you!
We have to help Touya and the others!
I won't lose a shootout!
Fu-Ruu, I'll be the one picking you off!
There's no telling what this opponent/　will try...! But still!
You're the one who killed Touya's father...!
A world that wants today to last forever/　will never see tomorrow!
The Fury have more than one future!
And Touya and the others are the proof!
What an incredible opponent...!
No wonder Gu-Landon's so confident...!
Even so, we can't back down!
Whatever your goal is,/　if you're going to attack us...!
If you don't want to get hurt, stay back!
You're letting me through!
Fairy, it looks like we can't avoid a fight...!
Yes... I understand.
What on earth are you all hiding?!
Vort! What is Herluga hiding?!
To take on the Gyanonia Ogre/　in this situation...!
Vort, tell me what you know!
Super Soul Saber as it is now/　can stand up to the Gyanonia Ogre!
Vort, stand down!/　Herluga is the one we have to fight!
Reggiane, I won't hand the Cross Gate/　over to you!
We have to break through that Gyanonia/　no matter what!
All you chase are research results...!/　Isn't the future they bring people/　what really matters?!
Herluga... I can't entrust/　Gadisword's future to you!
Let's settle this here, Fairy!
I don't want to rely too much on the/　Cross Gate's power, but...!
Now's not the time to be picky!
I'll crush Herluga's ambitions here!
Something like that showing up.../　It's a bad joke.
I won't let you do as you please,/　Debudedabide!
I won't let something like that run wild!
Here I come, Debudedabide!
Now it's controlling Zovorg units...!
I won't let Madnet do as it pleases!
I have to be careful not to get too close...!
If it's unmanned, I can go all out!
Even against a dragon, I just have to fight/　by the basics...!
A Mighty Walker can handle/　even monsters!
That hide looks tough,/　but I'll shoot right through it!
If it's as fragile as it looks,/　this would be easy, but...!
I do wonder why it talks like it's from Osaka,/　but...!
Here I come, Skull Knight!
Could XN-L have been targeting intelligent life/　from the very start...?!/　No, this is no time to think about that!
We can't let that thing descend to Earth!
I won't let it deny our existence!
Let's give it everything Super Soul Saber's got!
Vanish from this world, XN-L!
We're trying to get out of here!/　Don't get in our way!
I can't assume it'll fight/　like it did in the simulator...!
Verifying the data... Here I go!
No matter how many times you attack us!
I won't let Golaikunru do as it pleases!
Collecting data in a war might be/　efficient, but...!
I don't want to believe that girl's words/　were just an act...!
Is that really a Zovorg unit...?
If we hold back, the new model will/　take advantage of it!
Got you, Thick Cylinder!
Stay right there, Thick Cylinder!
Here you are, Big Shoulder!
Big Shoulder, huh. I won't let you!
There you are, White Horn!
White Horn's a tough opponent, but...!
Thorn... A formidable enemy...!
We have to get through this no matter what...!
Cupid acquired!
Cupid confirmed! Going in!
Here it comes, a Gasbra!
I'm going after that Gasbra!
Mass-produced Leonysis!
Gyanonia... I need to watch out for these!
Our attacks work on it!/　I can't let fear get to me...!
Time for you to disappear, Lamaris!
I'll take them down one at a time!
With the GG's firepower, Lamaris are nothing!
Akemi, let's wipe out these Lamaris already!
I know! Here I go!
Ugh, it's even creepier now...!
Disappear, Lamaris Kaana!
The bigger it gets, the easier it is to hit!
Kaana type or not, I'll take you down!
No matter how big it gets,/　Super Soul Saber can handle it!
Lamaris Ida... I'll shoot right through you!
So that's the Ares Geist...!
We have to make an opening for Arieil!
You're getting out of the way!
You're not getting away!
Still in range!
If I can't strike back here,/　what kind of Gunner Guard am I?!
Now it's my turn!
My payback hurts, you know...!
To keep them from pressing the attack...!
I have to turn this around...!
I can't let them get away like this...!
I-Is this the end?!
I-I'm hit!!
As long as Soul Saber can move, I'll fight!
Purging damaged armor! Recalibrating balance!
I refuse to die without ever really/　falling in love!
Toughness is supposed to be the Mighty/　Walker's selling point...!
Ngh! The pedals are heavy!/　At this rate, the verniers...!
I-I won't say it's impossible!/　I'll turn this around somehow!
Th-That sound... Are the hip motors catching?!
Ugh... It's nothing but warning lights...!
A-Are we done for...?!!
Uh-oh, Akemi's vitals...!
I-I'm fine... I'm still fully conscious...
The verniers are losing thrust...?!
Looks like we'll just have to limp along!
G-Guess all we can do is believe...
Yes, in ourselves...
And in this Super Soul Saber...!
The GG's armor got this badly...!
We can't take another hit!
I know!
We haven't lost yet, Jua-Mu!
A-Al-Van... He's s-strong...!
S-So this is what a Fury knight can do...!
They've already seen through our habits...!
Touya and the others are giving it their all,/　so we can't go down...!
He has his own convictions too, doesn't he...!
Vort... You'd really...!
Like I'd give up here!
Akimi! Fairy! Are you okay?!
Yeah, more or less...!
Don't worry about me. Just focus on Vort...!
Our Siebe Drive's okay, right...?
Y-Yes, somehow...!
Then we can still fight... and we will!
I completely misread the Skull Knight's moves...!
Calling it unpredictable makes it sound nice,/　but...!
If we lose to XN-L here,/　everything we've done so far...!
I have to get out of the Zeranio's line of fire...!
Ugh, are we no match for Thorn...?!
Output's dropping! I have to stabilize it!
Even this mistake will help/　Soul Saber's future development!
If only I'd reacted faster...!
I don't think I'm relying on the GG loadout's/　armor, but...!
Don't panic...!/　Deal with what I can, one thing at a time!
Ugh, things are starting to look bad...?!
Even with the GG loadout,/　taking any more damage would be bad...!
Ngh, the left knee joint's range of motion/　is narrowing...?!
Akimi, damage control!
Already on it!
We took more damage than I thought...!
But output's stable! We can still fight!
No need to apologize, Akemi!
Right, they won't get any further!
Ngh! It's heavier than before,/　so I have to move even quicker!
The left wing took a hit!
Fire the No. 4 thruster to keep balance!
Roger!
Ngh, the left side's heavy...?!
Roger, I'll check the center of gravity!
We got hit! Are you two okay?!
I'm fine too!
We held out, Jua-Mu!
We have to stop Al-Van somehow...!
The Fury knights really are strong...!
Karo-Ran, pulling a move like that...!
The Zee-Gadin.../　It's not just big...!
Don't think you can keep up this pace,/　Iradoya!
I took your hit, Gomoudokka!
Reggiane! Something like that/　won't stop us!
Ugh, we can't match its speed...!
I'll find an opening in Vort's defenses...!
He's doing a good job of shutting us down...!
You don't intend to give us any chance/　to strike back, do you, Vort...!
Doesn't he realize disaster could fall/　on him too?!
He only looks forward, in the worst way...!
Whatever Debudedabide does, I'll endure it!
It's a dragon, all right. Its power and speed/　are something else...!
Being a skeleton makes it nimble...?!
I won't let XN-L go any further!
Did it get feedback on our tactics...?!
I won't let you near those two units!
Getting hit by that really hurts...!
Even though we have data on the high-end/　models...!
I can't keep taking Thorn's attacks!
I can't shake off a Cupid...!
I wasn't underestimating the Gasbra, but...!
The Leonysis is faster... I know that!
Now that I've decided to fight,/　even against a monster...!
I can't believe Lamaris did this much...!
That Kaana type is fast...!
Looks like it didn't just get bigger...!
You overpowered us, Ares Geist!
Phew, the GG loadout's armor saved us.
...That attack was surprisingly light.
Losing that part won't affect combat,/　and it's easy to repair!
Do I need to move more boldly...?
The GG loadout's armor isn't easy to pierce!
It'll take more than that!
I know I can't move like I do/　with the FF loadout, but...!
Next time I have to dodge properly...!
Ngh! It hit us!
Relax, it's not a big hit.
Don't count too much on the GG's armor!
Sorry, Akimi!
Dodge the next one, okay?!
Even with better mobility than before...!
It only scratched the outer armor.
Heh, that's the Gunner Guard for you.
But I'll dodge the next one!
I knew that attack was coming!
Let's just be glad we avoided a direct hit.
Akemi, start your evasive motion/　0.5 seconds sooner./　I'll give you a signal too.
I won't let Jua-Mu push me around!
That Raftclans is fast, all right...!
That didn't hurt, Fu-Ruu!
If you're not using Larseilam,/　there's a way to fight you!
So what, Gu-Landon!
His attacks are relentless...!
Do you think this is a game, Gomoudokka?!
Ngh, it's overwhelming us with speed!
It's figured out we accelerate slower/　than the FF...!
I couldn't read Vort's movements...!
It's not your fault, Fairy!
Reggiane! Trying to hold us back is useless!
Floraga's power is much greater than this!/　Be careful, Akemi!
Yes, I know!
Debudedabide's attacks are hard to read...!
That didn't hurt, Crystal Dragoon!
I have to watch the Skull Knight closely...!
XN-L, what an attack...!
Individually, they don't seem/　like much, but...
Like I'd lose to Lamaris!
I have to dodge the Kaana type's attacks/　without fail...!
I'll endure even the Ida type's attacks!
Like I'd lose to a Zovorg machine!
That's it, aim for me!
The GG can take even a battleship's fire!
Against Thorn,/　this much can't be helped...!
A hit from a Cupid is nothing!
That Gasbra sure moves a lot...!
It's not as fast as Sieg's Leonysis, but...!
It's lighter than it looks!
We lost balance, I have to fix it now!
I won't let you wreck Soul Saber!
Too bad for you!
The GG loadout can take some of this, but...
Like I'd let something like that hit me!
Even in the GG, I can dodge!
Nice job, Akemi!
Whoa, close one!
Don't worry, I'm not getting hit.
Thanks to the Saber Booster,/　the GG loadout's mobility is up too!
I've built up experience too, you know!
Dodged it!/　Fairy, keep the support coming!
Jua-Mu, you underestimated the Mighty Walker!
So-Des, I can see your attacks coming!
Al-Van... That was way too close...!
Looks like you guessed wrong, Karo-Ran!
Let's keep taking on Vort,/　Fairy!
Right, got it!
Reggiane, what are you aiming at?!
So it's not even trying to aim properly?!
Is it just showing off its power...?!
I don't want to see a display like that!
We can't let Soul Saber be controlled.
I won't fall for that, Debudedabide!
You can't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
I dodged it, Skull Knight!
I dodged it.../　That means we can stand up to XN-L!
We can hold our own against Zovorg machines!
We have your spec data!
I was keeping an eye on the Zeranio-class's/　line of fire!
I'll find a way to fight even Thorn!
Like I'd lose to a Cupid!
A Gasbra's no match for us!
Slower than Sieg's Leonysis.
That thing's creepy...!
I'd rather not see that thing up close.
No matter how big the Lamaris get!
I should be able to move a little faster...
That was a little too close...
Nice evasion with that timing...
It's thanks to your support, Fairy.
If I hadn't dodged the Emperor Unit's attack...!
Vort, you...!
Let's try another approach, Fairy!
That's useless!
All right, I blocked it!
That attack won't reach me!
That weapon won't work on me!
Out of ammo in the GG loadout...?!
Geez! What am I doing?!
I need to resupply...!
I can't aim at it from that position...!
...! Where did it go?!
It's out of the GG loadout's range...!
Supporting allies is the GG's specialty!
We're still here!
I have to prove the Mighty Walker's worth!
Kota, leave the rest to me!
I'll cover you! Fall back a bit, Kota!
I can't let Shoko's effort go to waste!
Major Kai, I'll cover you!
Moving in to support, Lieutenant Lamia!
I have to cover Lieutenant Hugo!
Leave it to me, Lieutenant Aqua!
Arado, I'll cover you!
Right where Seolla drove it...!
Latune, I'll go!
Radha drew the enemy in...!
Major Gilliam, I'll support you!
Touya, leave the rest to us!
I'll cover you, Lieutenant Calvina!
Sieg, leave the rest to me!
I'll help you, Sieg!
Sally, I'll back you up!
Thanks to you, it's an easy shot, Sally!
Soul Saber should be able to take it!
The Mighty Walker is tough, you know!
This is a Gunner Guard's job too!
Please, let me make it in time!
Kota, fall back!
The G-Thundergate's being targeted!
Touya, get out of there!
Lieutenant Calvina, please fall back!
I won't let them shoot Sieg down!
There's no need to rush, Sieg!
I have to get in front of Sally...!
We help each other out, right, Sally?!
Let's finish this in one go!
I have to make the most of this chance!
We can still make it now!
It's still in range... Then!
There!
Please, hit!
Go down!
Take this!
Heavy Rifle!
Fire!
Fire!
At this distance...!
I'll hit it!
One more shot!
Target locked!
Take that!
Take that!
Dread Formation! Fire!!
All guns, open fire!
A full course of bullets and missiles!/　Enjoy every bite!!
All guns, open fire!
Triple Cannon!!
Not done yet!!
Triple Cannon!
Fiiire!!
One more strike!
Force Blaster, active!
Target locked on!
Gooooo!!
Force Blaster, deploy!
Don't move from there...!
Now! Fiiire!!
Akimi, I'm using the Buster Blaster!
Roger! Limiter, release!
Chest, open!
FFP, release!
Maximum power!
Finish it, Akemi!
Right! Here I go!!
Buster Blaaaaster!!
Akemi, finish it with the Buster Blaster!
Maximum output!
Do it, Akemi!
Buster Blaster!
Fiiire!!
Triple Impact!
Take this too!!
Full barrage!
Have this too!!
Twin Long Cannon, active!
Take this!!
Akemi, raising the barrels!
This weapon should reach!
Fire!!
Not yet!
Goooo!!
You've stopped moving!
This ends now!!
I'm using the Ultimate Blaster!
Right!
Chest open, FFP release!
Mode, standby.
Ultimate!
Maximum! Powerrr!!
Now!
Akemi!
Blaaaaster!!
Haaaaaah!!
I'm using the GG's trump card!
Got it!
Limiter, release! Full output!!
Finish it!
Ultimate Blaster!!
Goooooooo!!
